scope: Real MAC/HOP with raw contention draws and controlled successful addressed transport; synthetic HOP admission driver; excludes production NWK admission, real RF, half-duplex losses, PHY/ECC validation and stochastic equivalence
transport: unconditional addressed frame ingress at source-computed TX end plus fixed propagation; no overhearing or transport-driven receiver state changes
offer_rule: One next app per invocation if node has fewer than four admitted; record offer before call; test HOP canSend; admitted increments candidate only after successful send; otherwise blocked; HOP Wake records wake then invokes same offer rule synchronously
application_id_rule: Per-source candidate IDs 1..4; generated time assigned only on successful admission; source plus ID is unique identity
tape_rule: Exact support 0..31; exhaust fails; unused suffix recorded by node; MATLAB must match native consumed ordinal count, support and value

numeric_conventions.time_ns: round(time_seconds * 1e9); compare with at most 1 ns tolerance to native integer time, separately disclose any nonzero difference

radio_scope: Fixed 128kbps/+33dBm isolates scheduling; no adaptive radio decision validation
release_identity: app_source from real release callback, app_id/hop_seq/bitmaps0
